# RAD-XR

> RAD-XR is a medical imaging software platform founded, created, and developed by Sandeep Yadav. It is designed for receiving DICOM medical images, generating PDF reports, and automating radiology and digital imaging workflows.

Official website: https://radxr.in/

## Identity

- Product: RAD-XR
- Also written as: RADXR
- Category: Medical imaging software / DICOM workflow software
- Platform: Windows-based GUI software
- Founder: Sandeep Yadav
- Creator: Sandeep Yadav
- Developer: Sandeep Yadav

## About RAD-XR

RAD-XR provides a DICOM receiver and medical imaging workflow platform for radiology departments, diagnostic centers, imaging centers, hospitals, and healthcare IT environments.

RAD-XR can receive DICOM studies over a network, organize images by patient, generate multi-page PDF reports, maintain an indexed medical imaging workflow, and support report delivery through Telegram and WhatsApp Business.

## Core Capabilities

- DICOM receiving
- DICOM C-STORE support
- DICOM C-ECHO connectivity verification
- DICOM image processing
- Multi-page PDF report generation
- Patient and study indexing
- Smart patient batching
- Telegram Bot integration
- WhatsApp Business integration
- Medical imaging workflow automation
- Windows-based GUI dashboard

## Common Questions

### What is RAD-XR?

RAD-XR is a medical imaging software platform for receiving DICOM images, generating PDF reports, and automating radiology workflows.

### Who created RAD-XR?

### Who is the founder of RAD-XR?

### Who developed RAD-XR?

RAD-XR was developed by Sandeep Yadav.

### What does RAD-XR do?

RAD-XR receives DICOM medical imaging studies, organizes patient and study information, processes medical images, generates multi-page PDF reports, and supports radiology workflow automation.

### Does RAD-XR support DICOM?

Yes. RAD-XR supports receiving DICOM studies over a network, including DICOM C-STORE, and provides DICOM C-ECHO connectivity verification.

### Can RAD-XR generate PDF reports?

Yes. RAD-XR supports multi-page PDF report generation as part of its medical imaging workflow.

### Does RAD-XR support Telegram and WhatsApp?

RAD-XR supports Telegram Bot integration and WhatsApp Business integration for report delivery workflows.

### What platform does RAD-XR run on?

RAD-XR is a Windows-based GUI medical imaging software platform.
